profile.headline: AI Specialist
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: I am an engineer, physicist, and educator with a passion for complex problem solving. I have extensive experience designing and maintaining distributed systems, blockchain networks, distributed ledger technologies, and event driven systems in the context of financial services. I am very comfortable at delivering engineering efficiency in highly secure, highly regulated environments and pride myself on communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

positions.title: Head Of Development
positions.description:
Research, develop, and implement department wide policies - including coding standards, code review procedures, CI/CD procedures, remote work, and external vendor engagement

Concurrently manage software development lifecycle for multiple production platforms

Concurrently manage multiple agile software teams

Mentor career development of internal engineering team via 1:1 reviews

Identify gaps in resources, develop job specifications to address required resources, and conduct interviews of potential candidates

Manage external vendors across international time zones

Transition production grade systems to new platforms to improve efficiency and reduce cost

Aggregate input from product teams, sales teams, and other key stakeholders to prioritize software development tasks

positions.title: Teacher of Physics
positions.description: Responsible for facilitating several algebra-based physics classes based on PUM curriculum for high school freshmen. Standardized math test scores increased ~14% during implementation of curriculum.

positions.title: Guest Lecturer
positions.description: Calculus-based Physics Instructor for the Rutgers Education Opportunity Fund Summer Institute. Topics included kinematics, dynamics, and statics.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Responsible for facilitating recitations twice a week for Extended Analytical Physics 116. Topics included  rotational dynamics, fluids, thermodynamics, and mechanical waves.

positions.title: Part-Time Lecturer
positions.description: Responsible for facilitating one recitation and one lab session per week for Physics for the Sciences 194. Topics included electricity and magnetism, mechanical waves, geometric/wave optics, and special relativity.
